test_overview: Regression test of core MVP functionality (flight logging with validation, logbook filters, analytics totals, currency calculations, CSV export) with Flight Templates and Saved Views present but not used. Reference dates: D0=2026-08-08, D_minus_30=2026-07-09, D_minus_60=2026-06-09. All 7 steps passed with full points. The app correctly created an Active aircraft (N123RG/Cessna 172S/Airplane/SEL), rejected an invalid time breakdown with a clear validation message and no persistence, saved corrected flights, filtered/searched/cleared correctly with most-recent-first ordering, computed analytics totals (2.3h total/PIC, 6 approaches), computed currency correctly (Airplane-SEL day 2/3 TO, 1/3 Ldg Not Current; night 0/3 TO, 1/3 Ldg Not Current; Airplane instrument Current with 6/6, Holds, Intercept/Track), and exported a CSV with correct formatting and no template/saved-view metadata. Non-fatal verifications (templates present in Add Flight, saved views present in Logbook and Analytics, ordering, no provenance indicator) all passed. Final score 43/43.

steps.description: test_create_aircraft — Created N123RG / Cessna 172S / Airplane / SEL via Aircraft Management page. Aircraft visible in the list (row-aircraft-1) with an 'Active' status badge, satisfying both verification criteria. 4/4 points.

test_log_flight_with_mvp_validation — (non-fatal) Flight Templates controls present in Add Flight (Apply Template dropdown + Save as Template button), not used. Save with Night Time 0.4 (1.0+0.4 != 1.5) was rejected: modal stayed open, no flight persisted, and validation error 'Day Time + Night Time must equal Total Time (got 1.0 + 0.4 = 1.4, expected 1.5)' shown. Corrected to 0.5 and saved successfully; flight found in logbook and detail view verified for all fields (date 2026-07-09, N123RG, KSFO->KLAX via V23 GMN, 1.5/1.0/0.5, PIC 1.5, 2 approaches, holds, notes). No template provenance indicator. 8/8 points.

test_log_second_flight_for_currency — Created second flight 2026-06-09 (D_minus_60), N123RG, KLAX->KSAN, 0.8/0.8/0, PIC 0.8, day TO/Ldg 1/1, night 0/0, 4 approaches, Intercept/Track, 'Regression flight 2'. Saved successfully; both flights visible in logbook by date, most recent first. 5/5 points.

test_logbook_filters_work — (non-fatal) Saved Views management present in Logbook; not created/applied. Manually applied date range 2026-06-09..2026-07-09, aircraft N123RG, search 'Regression': both flights appeared in most-recent-first order. Search 'flight 2' showed only the 2026-06-09 flight. Cleared filters: both flights visible again. 6/6 points.

test_analytics_totals — (non-fatal) Saved Views application present in Analytics; not applied. Set custom range 2026-06-09..2026-08-08 and aircraft N123RG. Overall Totals: Total Time 2.3h, PIC 2.3h, Approaches 6 (Flights 2). All correct. 6/6 points.

test_currency_calculations — Day/Night Currency card 'Airplane - SEL' (90-day window 2026-05-11..2026-08-08): Day Not Current TO 2/3 | Ldg 1/3; Night Not Current TO 0/3 | Ldg 1/3. Instrument Currency card category 'Airplane' (6-month): Approaches 6/6, Holds ✓, Intercept/Track ✓, status Current. All correct. 8/8 points.

test_export_excludes_template_data — Exported all flights as CSV (logbook.csv). Header row present; both flights present by date and Notes ('Regression flight 1'/'Regression flight 2'). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; all times one decimal place (1.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.8, 0.0). No template or saved-view metadata columns. 6/6 points.
